# Clementine Ainslie

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Music teacher  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c4 P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050), [v5 c20 P3](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Clementine is an exceptionally attractive woman of imposing height, light complexion, and serene countenance. She has a lofty pale brow, big blue eyes full of goodwill, and smooth, tight braids of hair the shade of fresh molasses taffy. She is noted for her sweet, unhurried smile and stylish, pretty attire.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 c4 P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052), [v5 c13 P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007), [v5 c13 P8](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0008), [v5 c14 P39](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0039), [v5 c20 P9](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Universally regarded as a remarkably sweet, gentle, and gracious woman, Clementine retains a youthful sense of joyful wonder toward existence. She possesses deep empathy, patience, and understanding, showing genuine interest and care for others. Though generally tranquil and dignified, she has a subtle spark of firm temper when provoked.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c4 P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052), [v5 c12 P5](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0005), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009), [v5 c20 P9](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0009), [v5 c20 P18](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0018), [v5 c32 P31](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0031)_

## History

Clementine grew up in a strict Episcopalian family. At seventeen, her fiancé Martin Crawford was lost at sea, an event that deeply affected her. After her mother's death when Clementine was twenty-five, she and her older sister Harriet swore a mutual oath across their mother's Bible never to marry and to live together for life. She spent years giving music lessons to local children and living quietly in her home on the hill. During an autumn evening at a hidden spring in Fern Hollow, she struck up an acquaintance with the Presbyterian minister, John Ashdown. Their acquaintance turned into a courtship as Ashdown frequented her home, but when he proposed, Clementine reluctantly rejected him in writing due to her binding vow to Harriet. Following the rejection, she visited Portmaris to recover her health. Later, when Harriet wished to marry Lionel Fairlie, Clementine released her sister from the vow. After young Ida Ashdown came to plead with her to marry her father, Clementine sent John Ashdown a note arranging a meeting at the spring, leading to their betrothal.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c13 P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000), [v5 c13 P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 c21 P24](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0024), [v5 c21 P30](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0030), [v5 c22 P41](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0041), [v5 c26 P15](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0015), [v5 c32 P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 c32 P24](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0024), [v5 c34 P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 c34 P24](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0024), [v5 c34 P44](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0044), [v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Distant relative of Lorna Ainslie  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066)</sub>
- Lost her father when she was three years old  <sub>[v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)</sub>
- Her youthful betrothed, Martin Crawford, drowned in a shipwreck off The Magdalens when she was seventeen  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c13 P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000)</sub>
- Her young brother passed away many years ago  <sub>[v5 c13 P15](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0015), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)</sub>
- Took a solemn vow on her mother's Bible with her sister Harriet never to marry  <sub>[v5 c21 P23](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0023), [v5 c21 P24](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0024)</sub>

> My inability to become the wife of your father is not on account of you poor little souls. Such an idea never entered my mind. You are not bad—I never imagined you were. There—Ida, there was a completely different reason.  <sub>[v5 c34 P17](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0017)</sub>
